'''Ominous Star''' is the third act in [[Chapter I]] of the [[Main Quests]].

==Steps==
#Go to Qichi Village
#Clear the Tacet Field
#Purge the Tacet Field
#Investigate the Three Locations
##Tattered Wooden Plaque
##Suspicious Embers
##Strange Tacet Discord
#Investigate where the weird noises are coming from
#(Optional) Question Scar
#Investigate the clues Scar provided
#Follow the TD to find more clues
#Investigate places where the TD stayed
#Tell Scar your theory of what happened
#Defeat Scar and break out of his Elysium
##Break Scar's Elysium
##Venture deeper into the Elysium
##Defeat enemies inside the Elysium
##Find Scar
##Defeat Scar
#Head to the direction Yangyang pointed to
#Activate the mechanism with the complete Wooden Plaque
#Enter the cavern
#Go deep into the cavern
#Follow the mysterious TD
#Investigate the diary pages under the tree
#Talk to Yangyang

==Gameplay Notes==
* Completing the "Investigate the Tattered Wooden Plaque" step will award the player {{Item|Wooden Plaque: Left}}.
* Completing the "Head to the direction Yangyang pointed to" step will award the player {{Item|Wooden Plaque: Right}}, fusing it immediately with {{Item|Wooden Plaque: Left}} to create {{Item|Restored Wooden Plaque}}.
* Completing the "Investigate the diary pages under the tree" step will award the player {{Item|A Diary}} and the ''[[Rover's Journey]]'' [[trophy]] ''[["Buried under the Peach Blossom Tree..."]]''. It will also remove {{Item|Restored Wooden Plaque}} from the player's inventory.
* Completing the quest will award the player the ''[[Rover's Journey]]'' trophy ''[[Shepherd Game]]''.

==Dialogue ==
{{Quest Description|Forbidden memories of the past lay buried in ashes and ruins. The ominous "fractured star" beckons, holding untold secrets within its shadows. Secrets that still burn within a cindered heart.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(As the player goes to the designated location)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_1_17.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' This must be the place...
----
;(Clear the Tacet Field)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_1_13.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' I sensed something ominous from the leaf back there, but I couldn't pinpoint its source...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_1_14.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' And now, the hatred and pain is so strong in this place. I don't even need to concentrate to feel it...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_1_15.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Rover, something terrible must have happened here. 
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_1_16.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' We have to be cautious. This is a [[Tacet Field]]. Let's take out those [[Tacet Discord]]s first.
----
;(After purging the Tacet Field)
;(Huanglong I - Act III '''Ominous Star''' [Unlocked])
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_100_1.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' I think I've found something, [[Rover]].
----
;(Investigate the tattered wooden plaque)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_59_1.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Ritualistic wooden plaques...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_59_2.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' But why are they here? These plaques are usually placed in ancestral shrines...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_59_3.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' And they seem to belong to a different time...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_59_4.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' I remember reading about something like this. People held large-scale ancient rituals periodically in their villages, driven by certain beliefs.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_59_5_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_59_5_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' I see... Let's check somewhere else.
----
;(Investigate the suspicious embers)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_101_1.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' The area's a mess, but it doesn't look like a warzone. Someone was hurt and dragged away.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_101_2.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Look, there are many footprints here. These are... traces left by a fight.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_101_3.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Someone was injured...
----
;(Investigate the strange Tacet Discord)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_106_2.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Watch out!
<!-- :'''Strange Tacet Discord:''' Chirp... Chirp... -->
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_106_3.ogg}} '''Strange Tacet Discord:''' Ugh... Uh? Uhh...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_106_4.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Something's not right. Why wouldn't it attack us?
<!--:'''Strange Tacet Discord:''' Chirp... brother... -->
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_106_5.ogg}} '''Strange Tacet Discord:''' Nngh... brother...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_106_6.ogg}} '''Strange Tacet Discord:''' Help... Help...
:{{DIcon}} (Talk to it.)
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_106_9.ogg}} '''Strange Tacet Discord:''' Brother... help...
<!--::'''Strange Tacet Discord:''' Chirp... -->
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_106_10.ogg}} '''Strange Tacet Discord:''' Ugh...
::{{DIcon}} Who is your brother?
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_106_12.ogg}} '''Strange Tacet Discord:''' Help...
:{{DIcon}} (Attack it.)
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_106_17.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' W-wait! It doesn't look like it's trying to attack us...
::{{DIcon}}Do Tacet Discords have consciousness too?
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_106_19.ogg}} '''Strange Tacet Discord:''' Help...
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_106_20.ogg}} '''Strange Tacet Discord:''' ...Brother...
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_70_21.ogg}} '''Strange Tacet Discord:''' ...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_106_13.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' It seems to only repeat these lines... This is not a common Tacet Discord. 
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_106_14.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Tacet Discords attack other living beings, because they need to feed on those frequencies to make themselves whole again. When frequencies are scattered and recombined, a new Tacet Discord is born.   
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_106_15.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' This one probably devoured the frequencies of... humans.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_106_16.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Turning the last bits of a human's consciousness into such monotonous mumbles... Are these words the last cries of someone innocent? Who is behind this twisted plot?
:''Yangyang crouched down, hand on the Tacet Discord's head. As she focused on the Streams, sorrow filled her expression.''
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_2_36.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' I'm sorry...
:{{DIcon}} Are you talking to it?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_2_38.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' No, that's beyond my ability. I just sensed some complex feelings from it... A mixture of deep sadness and eager anticipation.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_2_39.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Rover... I think I know what's going on here.
:{{DIcon}} Go ahead.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_2_41.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' It seems to be begging for help, but it's not asking us to help it. I can sense the pained cries of this Tacet Discord... No, the cries of this whole village.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_2_42.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' The village is crying, waiting for rescue.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_2_43.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Something truly awful must have happened here... And the victims' {{Not a typo|Reverberations}} still linger.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_2_44.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Based on the evidence we've found and the condition of these ruins, that didn't happen all too long ago. I can still feel it in the Streams.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_2_45.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Perhaps the Tacet Field has kept this village from being discovered, or maybe someone has been intentionally concealing it. Anyway...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_2_46.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' There must be something we can do. We may find the victims nearby. I can feel someone connected to what happened here is still close... This place is dangerous.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_2_47.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' I'll inform [[Chixia]] about what happened here. Can we continue our search before the official investigators arrive?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_2_48.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Sorry, I know it doesn't sound very convincing... It's just a hunch of mine, and I don't have any evidence to back it up.
:{{DIcon}} No, not at all. I believe you.
:{{DIcon}} This is where [[Jinhsi]]'s token has pointed to.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_2_51.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Thank you, Rover. Please stay vigilant.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_2_52.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' As for the little one here... Let's leave it be.
----
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_3_53.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' These cards... I see...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_3_54.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' The [[Fractsidus]] is likely behind it all.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_3_55_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_3_55_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' The Fractsidus?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_3_56.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Yes. I don't know much about the Fractsidus, but as an Outrider, I've worked on related cases.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_3_57.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' It's a group of extremists obsessed with fusing humans with Tacet Discords. They've caused terror attacks of various scales around the world.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_3_58_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_3_58_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' Fusing humans and Tacet Discords...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_3_59.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' We've seen signs of their presence in [[Jinzhou]], left by lower-ranked members called "Artificers".
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_3_60.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Above the Artificers are the Overseers, leaders with eerie abilities and unknown intentions. They pose a far bigger threat...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_3_61.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' No one knows their true intentions. Some members speak of world destruction, while others claim they seek eternal power.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_3_62.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' And there is one particularly insane Overseer. He's crazy even by Fractsidus standards...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_3_63.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' A man who sees no order and revels in destruction... I've seen similar cards in the physical evidence file of the Fractsidus-related cases.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_3_64.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' They belong to this one Overseer I'm talking about. They call him... [[Scar]].
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_3_65.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' If he's responsible for what happened to these villagers... Who knows what kind of cruel and twisted atrocities he's capable of...
----
;(Investigate where the weird noises are coming from)
;(Cutscene plays)
<!-- Formatting: the following line doesn't have a section with character's name in-game.-->
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_4_1.ogg}} '''??:''' Guess you won't need my self-introduction. Aww, I spent so much time on it.

:{{DIcon}} You are... Scar?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_3.ogg}} '''Scar:''' If you need to hear it from me, then... Yes, I am Scar.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_4.ogg}} '''Scar:''' "Cruel and twisted maniac."
:{{DIcon}} Where is Yangyang?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_6.ogg}} '''Scar:''' We deserve a meeting free of such disturbances, don't you agree?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_7.ogg}} '''Scar:''' That girl... She's gonna sway your judgement.
:{{DIcon}} What do you want? <!--This response yields no extra lines. -->
:{{DIcon}} Give her back to me!
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_9.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Aw, so you really care about her.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_10.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Don't worry, I don't plan to make you hate me just yet... She is safe now.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_11.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Well, let's just enjoy our time together for the moment. Forget about that irrelevant person, will you? I have a lot to share with you.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_13.ogg}} '''Scar:''' To begin with... I heard you've lost your memories?
:{{DIcon}} How did you know?
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_16.ogg}} '''Scar:''' So it's true.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_17.ogg}} '''Scar:''' That makes sense, given how fragile you were when you woke up. Or I would've questioned the authenticity of those rumors.
::{{DIcon}} You followed me.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_19.ogg}} '''Scar:''' So you noticed? Aww, I'm flattered.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_20.ogg}} '''Scar:''' No need to be so on edge. By now you should've realized I'm just one of the onlookers.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_21.ogg}} '''Scar:''' But out of all the onlookers, I'm the only one who came forward to meet you, with absolute honesty.
:{{DIcon|Arrow}} Answer my question first.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_22.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Hehe... Indeed. I'll tell you then.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_23.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Before you knew anything about this world, you were already the center of conflict.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_24.ogg}} '''Scar:''' You are the unknown variable we've been waiting for. Forces have been fighting for possession over you.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_25.ogg}} '''Scar:''' From the moment you opened your eyes, everyone you've met, including that girl you care so much about... They all knew how valuable you are.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_26.ogg}} '''Scar:''' The world is a cruel place. You are a living, breathing person, but you're just a pawn to many.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_27.ogg}} '''Scar:''' That's why I'm here... Because I see you as a dear friend, and I want to tell you the truth. I am so, so sorry for everything you are about to face.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_28.ogg}} '''Scar:''' But truth hurts sometimes.
:{{DIcon}} As if you were any different.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_31.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Hehe, I know you are not one I can sway with simple words.
:{{DIcon}} You're just trying to make me join your side.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_32.ogg}} '''Scar:''' You could say I'm looking forward to your choice.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_61.ogg}} '''Scar:''' My goal is simple. I just want to deepen our mutual understanding, nothing more.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_62.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Come on. Observe the surroundings a little more, and tell me what you see.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_63.ogg}} '''Scar:''' As you learn more about this world, your true desires will surface, and our little game will become... even more entertaining.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_35.ogg}} '''Scar:''' And before that, I don't want anyone to disturb my precious alone time with you... That's all.
:{{DIcon}} What did the Fractsidus do to this village?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_37.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Aww. Why do you have to assume we are the culprits?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_38.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Maybe you should be asking me what actually happened here.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_39.ogg}} '''Scar:''' I won't tell you everything just yet. That's too boring. As I said, why don't you take a look around and see for yourself?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_64.ogg}} '''Scar:''' So. Go ahead, what do you see?
:{{DIcon}} A large-scale ritual.
:{{DIcon}} People were injured.
:{{DIcon}} A strange Tacet Discord.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_43.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Bravo! Didn't think you'd catch on to that!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_44.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Now, what is the conclusion you've drawn?
:{{DIcon}} The Fractsidus manipulated the villagers.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_47.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Ah, how typical. The age-old tale of savage wolves and helpless lambs. Good and evil as clear as day. It's a tired story that people cling to in their mundane lives. Oh, how it keeps them in check.       
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_48.ogg}} '''Scar:''' But let me ask you this: do you truly believe the real world can be that simple?
:{{DIcon}} The villagers killed each other.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_49.ogg}} '''Scar:''' I see you don't really trust those villagers.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_50.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Ah... So they were right about you. You are indeed quite exceptional.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_51.ogg}} '''Scar:''' I like it. Your keen observation, precise judgment, and accurate understanding of human nature...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_52.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Let me give you a couple more tips.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_53.ogg}} '''Scar:''' The truth is far more complicated than you think.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_54.ogg}} '''Scar:''' First, who are the players in our tale?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_55.ogg}} '''Scar:''' An innocent girl, a revered leader, and a flock of simple villagers.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_56.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Next, what makes up our main plot?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_57.ogg}} '''Scar:''' False devotion, fleeting kindness, collective deceit, senseless killings, and... The one vulnerable soul, pushed onto a path of destruction by the masses.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_58.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Now, Rover, the story is yours to spin.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_60_59.ogg}} '''Scar:''' I'm eager to hear your version after you've learned more.
----
;(Optional - Talk to Scar)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_1.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Huh? What is it? Are you back for some chit-chat?
:{{DIcon}} I need another hint.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_4.ogg}} '''Scar:''' I see. So you want to cheat, huh?
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_5.ogg}} '''Scar:''' A clever move, unbound by convention. I like it.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_6.ogg}} '''Scar:''' But I'm not telling you more. Not yet. Wouldn't want our first conversation to become a boring exchange of words, just parroting each other's lines.
:{{DIcon}} Just tell me the truth. All of it.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_7.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Ahahaha... No. I refuse.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_8.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Oh, and don't try to threaten me. You're not in a place to bargain, remember?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_9.ogg}} '''Scar:''' You don't want to disappoint me so soon, Rover.
:{{DIcon}} ...Fine. I'll go look for clues.
::''<small>(dialogue ends)</small>''
:{{DIcon}} (Attack him.)
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_12.ogg}} '''Scar:''' C'mon. No need to get so worked up.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_13.ogg}} '''Scar:''' I see you're itching for a fight, but our game isn't over yet.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_14.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Strike now and risk being crippled. And what a shame it would be to miss out on these crucial clues right in front of you.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_15.ogg}} '''Scar:''' After all this effort, do you truly want to throw it all away?
::{{DIcon}} ...Fine. I'll go look for clues.
:::''<small>(dialogue ends)</small>''
::{{DIcon}} (Attack him.)
:::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_18.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Aww, are you serious going to judge me off of those rumors alone?
:::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_19.ogg}} '''Scar:''' I knew it... Gentle lambs like me are bound to suffer. Never given a chance to speak for ourselves...
:::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_20.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Well then, I suppose I'll have to be a little more ruthless with you.
:::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_21.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Play nice and go investigate the clues in this village, then I might show your girl some "gratitude" for leaving us be.
:::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_22.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Otherwise... You may have to bid her farewell. Forever.
:::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_23.ogg}} '''Scar:''' What do you say?
:::{{DIcon}} ...Fine. I'll go look for clues.
::::''<small>(dialogue ends)</small>''
:::{{DIcon|Attack}} Shut up and fight me properly!
:::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_26.ogg}} :'''Scar:''' HAHAHAHA! You never cease to amaze me!
:::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_27.ogg}} :'''Scar:''' Such a burning desire for battle... How could I have the heart to decline?
:::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_61_28.ogg}} :'''Scar:''' As you wish, then...
::::''<small>(Cutscene: Scar materializes a card, then brings Rover along with him into his domain.)</small>''

;(Investigate the clues Scar provided)
:A crumpled page from a children's book rests on a torn piece of diary paper with childish handwriting.
:{{DIcon}} (Read [[Torn Page|the diary]].)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_62_1.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Our story begins here...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_62_2.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Once upon a time, in a peaceful village lived a flock of carefree lambs.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_62_3.ogg}} '''Scar:''' In the day they toiled for food, and when evening fell, they sought refuge from the looming threat of wolves.
:{{DIcon}} Quite the storyteller, aren't you?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_62_5.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Fables, stories told and retold through the ages. The ancient art of conveying hidden truths through fiction.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_62_6.ogg}} '''Scar:''' But they always draw from real life, don't they?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_62_7.ogg}} '''Scar:''' The same story gets told by many, and each person brings their own spin, their own focus.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_62_8.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Whatever you learn from it is just one of countless different interpretations.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_62_9.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Like us now, caught in a carefully crafted plot line... A scheme I had no hand in.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_62_10.ogg}} '''Scar:''' This village marks the beginning of my story with Jinzhou... Hehe....
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_62_11.ogg}} '''Scar:''' So that Magistrate led you here to meet me. Heh, such a clever move on her part.
----
;(Follow the TD to find more clues)
:The tree branches are loaded with paper slips, each containing someone's wish. The words on most of the notes are soaked and no longer legible.
:{{DIcon}} (Read [[Paper Strip|the paper slips]].)
:Another crumpled page from a children's book, half-buried in the mud.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_63_1.ogg}} '''Scar:''' One day, a shepherd visited the village.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_63_2.ogg}} '''Scar:''' The shepherd brought them promises of abundance and protection. The lambs, drawn in by his words, soon lived in comfort and security...
:{{DIcon}} Is that... the end of your story?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_63_4.ogg}} '''Scar:''' No, quite the opposite! The shepherd's arrival is only the beginning.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_63_5.ogg}} '''Scar:''' With a wave of his hand, the shepherd could grant their every wish.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_63_6.ogg}} '''Scar:''' His flock obeyed, bowing their heads, pleading for better food and shelter.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_63_7.ogg}} '''Scar:''' They no longer had to struggle for survival, as their once meager lives were replaced with endless luxury.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_63_8.ogg}} '''Scar:''' The flock worshipped their shepherd-turned-god, praising him and holding him in the highest regard...
:{{DIcon}} ...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_63_10.ogg}} '''Scar:''' What's wrong? Does my story make you uncomfortable?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_63_11.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Imagine you were one of those lambs, facing irresistible temptation and pressure from your peers. Wouldn't you bow down and beg for food from your master?
:{{DIcon}} We are all created equal. There should be no hierarchy.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_63_13.ogg}} '''Scar:''' Haha... So we agree already.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_63_14.ogg}} '''Scar:''' You are right, but the world we live in falls short of our ideals. The shepherd still reigns, and the lambs have grown complacent.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_63_15.ogg}} '''Scar:''' It's up to the two of us to make that ideal world a reality.
----
;(Follow the TD to find more clues)
:A crumpled page from a children's book, silently resting on the ground.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_4_64_1.ogg}} '''Scar:''' The lambs reveled in endless bonfire parties, celebrating their new god every night, except... the one little black lamb.
